content: It is known that for the previous generation of word embedding models (`static' ones like word2vec BIBREF2, where a word always has the same representation regardless of the context in which it occurs), lemmatization of the training and testing data improves their performance. BIBREF3 showed that this is true at least for semantic similarity and analogy tasks.
